lede: Town Council meets Tuesday the 27th with a packed agenda that touches the gondola project directly — they're voting on the Fourth Supplement to the Gondola IGA, extending cost-sharing on the 2027 planning budget, plus first readings on two ordinances including a Telluride Energy Mitigation Program amendment. Ouray County commissioners are also busy that day, voting on a fifth extension of their Emergency Disaster Declaration and fielding vacancy requests under an austerity resolution, while a separate work session digs into a proposed EMS and Ridgway Fire merger — the kind of structural change that affects response times and budgets for years.
